messages:
maria: Hey - quick UX question: when someone pins a per-route model preset in Console, can we show a "quota + telemetry preview" inline so PMs know cost impact before save? e.g., token burn estimate + sampling signal change.

ash: yes pls. current preview only shows latency estimate. need per-route quota peek. :eyes:

kevin: agree. also need to surface routing fallback behavior (if preset not available show fallback model and cost diff). otherwise teams get surprised.

olivia: could we reuse the existing cost-preview endpoint? /api/preview/route-cost? It returns token_estimate and sample_delta. we might need an expanded payload.

maria: linking api contract idea:

```
POST /api/preview/route-cost
{
  "route_id": "route-123",
  "model_preset": "gptx-4q-8k",
  "traffic_sample_pct": 10
}
```

returns token_estimate, latency_p50, fallback_model, sample_signal_change

ash: UX suggestion: small pill next to "Save preset" that shows "≈ 1.2k tokens / call · +12% sample signal" and a chevron to expand timeline for telemetry (error rates + sample delta).

kevin: Implementation note: preview should use rate-limited cached calc to avoid overload on cost service. maybe compute async and fall back to "estimate pending". Also flag for canary rollout where preview should show both canary and baseline.

olivia: On telemetry side, we can show expected change in sampling for metrics already on that route (latency, error, halluc rate). But we need mapping from model preset -> telemetry delta model. research team can provide a small regression matrix.

maria: Good. Also need saved-query interaction: if a saved query pins a model, saving should prompt "this will affect X routes / Y users" — compute affected routes.

ash: small UX edge-case: permissions — only org admins should see total user impact. Non-admins get "affects N routes you have access to".

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging preview service rollout at 2024-05-10 02:00 UTC :rocket:

kevin: let's sync infra on caching layer. I'll open a follow-up PR to eng-platform. :+1:

maria: I'll mock the pill copy + wireframe in Figma and drop link later. Thanks all.
